## HMO Performance System
Turns raw claims data into the five numbers an HMO manager needs every week, and the providers to look at first.

Every Monday it reads claims (claim_id, provider, enrollee, diagnosis, amount, submitted, decided, status) and emails the medical director a summary: volume, cost per enrollee, approval rate, turnaround, providers whose cost per claim is an outlier, and likely duplicate claims.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/hmo-performance-system
